scenario: A CACHE ENTRY'S TTL replayed ([LFST.9.1], [NSTG.2.4.2]). `rw` writes "k" with a 10_s TTL at 0; `rr` reads it and emits what it read into a String slot, at 5_s (a hit, `v=[7]`) and at 11_s (expired, a miss, `v=[]`). The deadline is engine state no atom carries, so the replay must expire the entry from its own clock, and the hit-or-miss is in a compared fact. Paths: libds records through `rfcs/codec.c`'s recorder and replays through `ds_rfcs_replay_*` (pyds `Engine.record` / `Engine.replay`), which byte-compares each re-derived RuleFireAnnotation and FactEmit; the Mercury runtime records through `ds.rfcs` and replays through `ds.replay`.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    tag: String key

schema Got scope ttl 1_h:
    tag: String
    text: String

rule rw:
    Trig t where t.tag == "w"
->
    cache key: "k" value: 7 ttl: 10_s

rule rr:
    Trig t where t.tag != "w"
->
    let v = cached("k")
    emit Got tag: t.tag text: "v=[{v}]"
